body:
Fixes #7498, Fixes #7548, Fixes #7493, Fixes #7492, Fixes #7518, Fixes #7553, Fixes #7583, Fixes #7512 + Part of #7631

PR₁ of the consolidated skills batch #7631 (skills seat, round 1). All eight members carry maintainer rulings recorded 2026-08-11 on their own threads; this PR executes them without re-opening any. **ADR-class: skills updates are human-review, human-merge** (「所有 skills 的更新和 adr 类似,需要人工审核」, #7548 — which this very PR also encodes). ⛔ Nobody merges, enqueues, or arms auto-merge; the maintainer merges manually. PR₂ (structural compression, ~1400–1600 lines target) strictly serializes behind this PR's human merge.

## Per-member checklist (落点 | before | after)

### #7498 — four-lens block on every needs-user-decision card
Reused **verbatim** from closed PR #7552 (branch `claude/issue-7498-decision-four-lens`, head `24934cf`), re-anchored onto current main by cherry-pick with zero conflicts (first commit of this branch). Both rulings land: the required four-lens block at step-0 filing and step-8 escalation (card-face serialization of the unchanged three-axis frame — `check:skill-frame-sync` stays green, 4 copies isomorphic); the step-3 Blocked-by-named selection tier (derived at read time, no stored label); the step-9 round-brief decision-dependents flag; the declined blanket-label option recorded with its revisit condition. The PM review of #7552 (ACCEPT, both open questions answered A) carries over.

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` step 0 | Maintainer-confirm class had no analysis requirement | requires the four-lens block from filing time
- SKILL.md step 8 | three-axis analysis only | + required four-line lens block, defined as the frame's card-face serialization
- SKILL.md step 3 | priority tiers ended at `target:` board | + named-by-`Blocked-by:` tier (fan-out ≥ 1) + declined-option record
- SKILL.md step 9 | decision-inbox metric bare count | + flags decision cards with open downstream dependents

### #7548 — skills updates are ADR-class + skills-seat registration
- SKILL.md step 7 ACCEPT path fork | fired on `docs/adr/**` only | fires on `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/skills/**`, `skills/**` (same three-part terminal state; one hit is enough, no proportional read; mixed diffs split)
- SKILL.md Guardrails | ADR + release prohibitions only | + skills entry quoting the ruling verbatim (「所有 skills 的更新和 adr 类似,需要人工审核」), both skill roots named, same revert mechanics
- SKILL.md domain-lane table | `skills/**` inside `domain:devx` row | `domain:skills` row (`.claude/skills/**` + `skills/**`, carved out of devx; second ruling quoted; 专题讨论 channel noted)
- SKILL.md 词表 roster | no `domain:skills` row | row → seat sticker #7623
- SKILL.md one-time-setup label loop | 10 domains | + `skills`

### #7493 — three-query release board (ruled most urgent)
- SKILL.md 发版板 consumers | two queries (objectstack + objectui); "a hit in cloud is a mislabel signal" | **three queries** (+ cloud); the mislabel clause **repealed** with the measured cost recorded (cloud#1222 invisible ~10h)
- SKILL.md 发版板 producers | two producers | + `repo:cloud` whole-repo seat (#6026) produces `target:*` in its own backlog, same one-producer-per-backlog discipline
- SKILL.md 发版时刻/清板 | cloud 不入板, advisory 单列 | cloud boards in its own repo; three boards all clear to cut; 三选一 per board by its own seat
- SKILL.md State model `target:` row + step-9 metric | sum of two | sum of three

### #7492 — merge-queue membership criterion + success sequence
- SKILL.md Operational note 1 | membership = `gh-readonly-queue/*` branch listing (「没有匹配分支才是真的没入队」) | membership = **`added_to_merge_queue` timeline event** (6/6 measured); branch reading demoted to batch-position only (positive hit still sufficient; absence no longer proves anything); `auto_merge`-field warning kept verbatim; two-reading rule kept
- SKILL.md note 1 (new sub-rule) | two identical-looking event names for opposite outcomes | success-sequence rule: `removed_from_merge_queue` → `merged` within ~1s = **landing**; real ejection = no `merged`, PR still open — "read the gap, not the event name"
- SKILL.md Operational note 21 | empty-field receipt = armed-but-not-enqueued, flip once | receipt has **zero discriminating power** (3/3 counter-tally #7506/#7508/#7605 + #7446 second timing shape); read membership per note 1 before flipping; `disable` does not dequeue but does clear the auto-merge flag

### #7518 — five measured shift lessons
- SKILL.md Operational note 2 | flaky-signature reading only | + third signature: no `merge_group` run of the PR's own = rebuild collateral (#7311); one receipted re-queue, second kick hands to the steward (#5810); ⛔ never re-queue without the receipt
- (lesson 2 lands in note 21 above, with #7492)
- SKILL.md State-model label discipline | hold comment = date/reason/restart condition | + opportunistic restart conditions must name trigger files; owning lane carries a dispatch-time check in its seat post (#5536, four unread firings)
- SKILL.md step 4 yield handoff | dev-diagnosis handoff only | + loser hands over its board readings (in-flight PRs, region declarations, serial constraints) — #7145, 69-second race, session-ID+timestamp arbitration
- SKILL.md step 1 | no lane-inventory query shape | whole-lane field-narrowed `list_issues` read, intersect locally; single-pm-state slices measured blind (#7243)

### #7553 — canonical claim spelling (direction 1, no predicate widening)
- SKILL.md step 4 claim template | spelling implicit in the template | one explicit line: first line begins literally with `Claim:` (optional blockquote); H2 predicate stays strict; 9/22 unreadable variants cited

### #7583 — bounded seat-post bodies
- SKILL.md 座位贴协议 | body = three sections, unbounded narration accreted (~61 KB on #6019) | fixed six-section current-state template (范围 | 当前 PM | 继承台账 | 热文件串行队 | 常设承诺 | 说明); shift narration lives on cards/PRs/round reports; takeover compaction standard step (edit history = archive)
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` | H1–H5 | + **H6** report-only: `pm:seat` body over ~10 KB (byte length); wired into the sweep; 4 new self-test cases (24 total pass)

### #7512 — dispatch contract outranks platform subscription (option a)
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` "Report at draft-PR time" | conflict resolution left for each dev to derive | explicit clause: the dispatch contract (report-at-draft, honest gate status, no idle-poll/self check-ins; PM owns CI convergence, ready-flip, landing) **outranks** platform-injected PR-subscription postures; #7477 resolution ruled correct
- SKILL.md step-5 prompt template (the verified dispatch-brief repeat) | no echo | one-line echo. The published `skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` was checked and does **not** repeat the L2/dispatch-brief clauses — left untouched, per the card's verify-before-echo condition
